required_units: Both declared configurations across all four pre2024 temporal folds; every artifact and full development prediction must be verified before selection
policy_family: One common threshold per configuration applied to its general binary scores; inspect all distinct pooled score thresholds, with score ties kept together
selection: Among thresholds and configurations passing every target, maximize true positives, then minimize false positives, then configuration id; if none pass selected_policy is null
diagnostics: Also report pooled AP, fold and subtype metrics, amount and history cohorts, train-development AP gaps, and maximum-recall P90 points without presenting a failed diagnostic point as an eligible policy
threshold_evaluation_limit: Each row is scored by a model fitted only on earlier rows, but selection and reporting use the same pooled development labels; not independent policy validation
excluded: No2024 label or score in selection; no runtime replacement, no relaxed targets and no fallback policy promotion
